paras: Emoia paniai, also known commonly as the coastal emo skink, is a species of lizard in the subfamily Eugongylinae of the family Scincidae. The species is endemic to Western New Guinea.
The specific name, paniai, refers to the Lake Paniai area in Western New Guinea.
Emoia paniai is known only from its type locality: "Paniai, Wissel Lakes, Irian Jaya".
The natural habitats at the type locality of Emoia paniai are forest, and grassland, at elevations of approximately 2,000 m (6,600 ft).
